text:
NASA ESCAPADE Earth Slingshot | Serve Physical AI | Google Watch BP AI | New Glenn 2027

In two days, NASA's twin Mars probes will fire engines while slingshotting past Earth — a first. Masya brings the facts, Vuhlyk brings the sarcasm:

1) Serve Robotics launches Physical AI Services (Nov 5): Serve Link (robot↔data-center connectivity), Data Curator (edge-case mining), and a sidewalk foundation-model data catalog. Bedrock Robotics is a launch customer. Delivery + hospital robots continue (TechCrunch + Serve IR).

2) Google Research Nature study (Nov 5): consumer smartwatch AI (PPG + accelerometer) detects signs of hypertension without cuff calibration; validated vs 24-hour ambulatory BP monitoring in 196 participants (~66% sensitivity / 90% specificity / ~81% PPV for initial screening). Exploratory screening research — NOT a diagnosis, NOT a commercial product claim (Nature + Google Research blog).

3) NASA ESCAPADE twin spacecraft: powered Earth flybys ~5 a.m. ET Sat Nov 7 and ~6 a.m. ET Mon Nov 9; ~9-minute trans-Mars injection burns; ~10-month cruise; Mars arrival Sept 7 & 9, 2027. Upcoming preview — burns not yet claimed done (NASA Science blog + EarthSky + NASA SVS).

4) Blue Origin delays next New Glenn flight to January 2027 while finishing Cape Canaveral pad rebuild after the May hot-fire mishap (CNBC + The Verge + FT). Schedule window only — no invented payload day.
